Peterson family · Person

Erik Hilmer Pettersson

1882–1962

Open in the family tree

Names in the records
Erik Hilmer Peterson, Hilmer Peterson, Erick Hilmer Petersen, Erick Hilmer Peterson
Born
May 14, 1882 · Rasbo, Uppsala, Sweden
Died
December 10, 1962 · Vernal, Utah
Burial
Vernal Memorial Park, Vernal, Utah

Born May 14, 1882, in Rasbo, Uppsala, Sweden. Married Mary Alvey on September 25, 1912, in Manti, Utah. They had nine children. He died December 10, 1962, in Vernal and was buried in Vernal Memorial Park. FamilySearch reports immigration in 1899; the earlier family letter differs, so the arrival date remains under review.
